meta.name: teach
meta.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在对话中学习新技能或概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想在工作区直接学习新东西
copy.tagline_en: Learn new skills or concepts through conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to learn something new directly in your workspace

howto.what: Claude 会创建一个教学空间，包含任务说明、参考资料、学习记录和课程文件。它会根据你的学习目标设计互动课程，并生成可打印的参考文档。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 教你某个技能或概念时触发。它会在当前目录下建立教学空间，并引导你完成学习。

say.text: 教我如何用Python写一个网页爬虫
say.note: Claude会创建教学空间并开始第一课

say.text: 我想学习瑜伽的拜日式序列
say.note: Claude会设计互动课程并生成参考文档

howto.what_en: Claude creates a teaching workspace with mission, references, learning records, and lessons. It designs interactive lessons tied to your goal and generates printable reference documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to teach you a skill or concept. It sets up a teaching workspace in the current directory and guides you through learning.

say_en.text: Teach me how to write a web scraper in Python
say_en.note: Claude will create a teaching workspace and start the first lesson

say_en.text: I want to learn the Sun Salutation sequence in yoga
say_en.note: Claude will design interactive lessons and generate reference documents
